title: Prefetch Policy Harmonization & Field Validation for Cost Optimization
creator: Priya Singh
description: Objective: define a harmonized, testable prefetch/cache policy DSL and rollout plan that reduces token spend on tail requests while preserving served-quality SLOs. This initiative will produce a canonical policy schema, a validation harness for offline traces, canary configurations for Dedicated pools, and a playbook for cross-team rollouts. Scope includes field-level TTLs, tenant affinity overrides, and integration points for Redwood Optimize recommendations. Excludes backend kernel changes and deep quantization experiments (handled in parallel epics).
success_metrics: 10-15% reduction in tail token spend for low-context requests
No >1.5x increase in median latency across canary customers
Policy validation pass rate >= 98% on historical workload traces
milestones: 2025-02-28: Validation harness completed and run against 6 weeks of traces
2025-03-07: Eng PRs for policy enforcement + canary config
2025-03-14: Canary field trial (3 tenants) + monitoring dashboards
2025-03-28: Rollout to Dedicated pools or rollback
expected_savings: Projected annualized token cost reduction: 12% (range 8-18%) for targeted workloads
